notes.title: Super X Chess 2023 patch 3
notes.content: Added new features for local multiplayer: Now you can choose your time limits from 1 minute to 2 hours and increment from 0 to 30 seconds per move. Also you can now play chess 960 on top of super 960 variant in local multiplayer mode. This is also recommended mode to play over internet with friends by utilizing steam's remote play feature (as the online multiplayer is old code and doesn't seem to deliver that well)

notes.title: Super X Chess patch 2023
notes.content:
Improved a bit the AI at higher levels:
- Made the AI think at lvl 10 for a bit longer, thus being able to spot a bit more
- Made the AI more likely to start the game without combining every move
- Made the AI less likely to sacrifice pawns at the start of the game
- Fixed the issue where the game thought it's draw because of insufficient material if the other player has only KnightPawn piece left
-Fixed the issue where the game thought it's draw because of insufficient material if the other player has only BishopBishop piece left

https://youtu.be/TlXXa8_JcBw[previewyoutube=TlXXa8_JcBw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Small fix
notes.content:
Fixed the issue of game not remembering the selected game mode.
Thanks to ACTIONBOMBA for reporting the issue.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Enabled mac and linux builds, as I managed to fix on mac and linux builds a major issue where the game gets stuck after completing the game. 

Fixed check detection when there's multiple rook+rook or bishop+bishop pieces. So now the game should work in these situations more reliably.

notes.title: Bug Fixes to Super X Chess
notes.content:
The bug fixes include:
1. Fixed a visual problems with En passant when observing a played game.
2. English grammar corrections to the tutorials, thanks to TraDukTer for a big help here.
3. Leaving a game in progress against the AI and then returning will not set the AI to 700 level anymore.
4. Made the shortcut icon much better, the old one was pretty bad as for some reason it wasn't very sharp. Now the icon is sharp and nice.
5. Updated Mac and Linux builds to 64-bit.

Also, Mlyst Corporation is progressing quite well with the new game, I would estimate that it will get launched during the next 1 or 2 months. So the new game takes some heavy inspiration from Super Hexagon and includes cool features to this type of games. But I will tell later more what those features are. This is not yet the proper trailer video, but more of a sneak peek for those who are interested.
Here is a small video clip of it showing it's main menu and some gameplay in the background:
[previewyoutube=zv4KShbjG80;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 1.21 is live
notes.content:
Fixed some issues brought by the new content of chess variants. For example..
-A couple of the variants didn't work. I tested the variants more to make sure that they work.
-White 2d Rook+Rook piece had wrong graphics, it didn't have the same look as all the other pieces.
-Pawn+Pawn piece was able to jump through pieces if it was on the 2nd rank (for white) or 7th rank (for black). (Pawn+Pawn piece couldn't be found from those places before the added chess variants).

notes.title: Patch 1.19 is live
notes.content:
Hello Super X Chessers!
Pleased to announce that this update includes..
1. Improved, more varied openings for the AI.
2. Cancel move functionality on right mouse button click
3. Other small fixes, such as prettier splash screen. ;)

Edit: Apparently there was still one really nasty issue with the tutorial, got that now fixed, too!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.18 is live
notes.content:
- Fixed Linux and Mac builds so that they should be now at least playable. (Sorry for not testing them very actively) And special thanks for Falconboy82 for reporting issues with Linux build.

-Added leaderboards shortcut button to "Played Games" submenu. This could be surprisingly important thing as now players could have more motivation to keep playing the game. For example, how about becoming the highest rated Super X Chess player in the world? Not that difficult right now. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Demo patch
notes.content: Demo is now also patched to include recent updates. (1.16, 1.14 etc.)

notes.title: Patch 1.14 is live
notes.content:
Issues that got fixed:
1: When a Pawn is promoted, the game always freezes in the battle of "local multiplayer".
2: "Played Games" does not work properly.

-Possibly fixed some problems with the game not rendering in 3d mode properly.
-Added more descriptions on why the game ends in a draw. The game now tells the cause of the draw like this: Fifty move rule, 3-fold repetition, Insufficient material to mate, Stalemate".

Thank you for ZoG for reporting these issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.12 is live
notes.content:
-Made still one weaker AI opponent to improve the player experience for the majority of people, who don't have much chess experience/knowledge/skill.
-Fixed a rare but very annoying issue where the game would switch sides with the AI.
-Fixed promotion panel graphics issue: the "promotion option" images were unclear on 3d mode.
-Fixed difficulty setting issue after playing tutorial and then continuing to play the game that wasn't finished.

notes.content:
Demo build had issues when the game was over:
"the game doesn't exit from "White wins" screen. after i have managed to start the new game somehow i see that i have 2 wins and 2627 losses - my rating went from 1000 to 52 - how that could be?"

Thanks for shpasic for reporting the issue.

notes.title: Demo released! You can now try Super X Chess for free!
notes.content:
[b]Demo includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability to play against AI on single player.
[*] All game modes: Super X Chess, Super960 and Normal Chess
[*] Tutorial for Super X Chess and Normal Chess
[/list]

[b]Demo doesn't include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Scenarios (over 60 different chess variants)
[*] Online multiplayer & Local multiplayer
[*] Ability to customize AI difficulty levels, but there's still ability to change the challenge level by adding bonus material to either to your opponent or to your own army. The difficulty level in the demo is still a suitable challenge for many players and it serves as a good, soft introduction to the game.
[/list]

I also keep updating the game and these updates will not be included in the demo.

To play the demo a PC with 64-bit processor is needed. Full version is available on Mac and Linux!
